31314-the-trumpeter-of-sa-kkingen-a-song.title: A Song from the Upper Rhine.
31314-the-trumpeter-of-sa-kkingen-a-song.creator: Unknown
31314-the-trumpeter-of-sa-kkingen-a-song.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Who is yonder light-haired stranger  Who there like a cat is roaming  O'er the roof of Don Pagano?"--  Thus asked many honest burghers,  Dwellers on the Isle of Capri,  When they from the market turning  Looked up at the palm-tree and the  Low-arched roof of moorish fashion.

7181-the-bushman-life-in-a-new-country.title: Life In A New Country
7181-the-bushman-life-in-a-new-country.creator: Unknown

arxiv-2310-16798.title: Reachability in Continuous Pushdown VASS DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX CCS: Theory of computation Models of computation
arxiv-2310-16798.creator: A. R. Balasubramanian, Rupak Majumdar, Ramanathan S. Thinniyam, Georg Zetzsche
arxiv-2310-16798.description: Abstract . Pushdown Vector Addition Systems with States (PVASS) consist of finitely many control states, a pushdown stack, and a set of counters that can be incremented and decremented, but not tested for zero. Whether the reachability problem is decidable for PVASS is a long-standing open problem. We consider continuous PVASS , which are PVASS with a continuous semantics.

arxiv-2402-05525.title: Differentially Private Deep Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2402-05525.creator: Alexandre Rio, Merwan Barlier, Igor Colin & Albert Thomas
arxiv-2402-05525.description: Abstract We address private deep offline reinforcement learning (RL), where the goal is to train a policy on standard control tasks that is differentially private (DP) with respect to individual trajectories in the dataset. To achieve this, we introduce PriMORL , a model-based RL algorithm with formal differential privacy guarantees.

arxiv-2407-07074.title: Hyperion – A fast, versatile symbolic Gaussian Belief Propagation framework for Continuous-Time SLAM
arxiv-2407-07074.creator: David Hug, Ignacio Alzugaray, Margarita Chli
arxiv-2407-07074.description: Abstract CTSLAM ( CTSLAM ) has become a promising approach for fusing asynchronous and multi-modal sensor suites. Unlike discrete-time SLAM , which estimates poses discretely, CTSLAM uses continuous-time motion parametrizations, facilitating the integration of a variety of sensors such as rolling-shutter cameras, event cameras and IMU .

arxiv-2407-11240.title: Making New Connections: LLMs as Puzzle Generators for The New York Times’ Connections Word Game
arxiv-2407-11240.creator: Tim Merino, Sam Earle, Ryan Sudhakaran, Shyam Sudhakaran, Julian Togelius
arxiv-2407-11240.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tim Merino, Sam Earle, Ryan Sudhakaran, Shyam Sudhakaran, Julian Togelius. The Connections puzzle is a word association game published daily by The New York Times (NYT). In this game, players are asked to find groups of four words that are connected by a common theme. While solving a given Connections puzzle requires both semantic knowledge and abstract reasoning, generating novel puzzles additionally requires a form of metacognition: generators must be able to accurately model the downstream reasoning of potential solvers.

arxiv-2412-13077.title: What do we know about cosmic rays with energies above 5 EeV?
arxiv-2412-13077.creator: Jonathan Biteau, 1, 2 for the Pierre Auger Collaboration 3
arxiv-2412-13077.description: Abstract Cosmic rays begin to reveal their secrets at energies above 5 EeV. Beyond this characteristic energy, known as the spectral “ankle”, the arrival-direction data from the Pierre Auger Observatory show anisotropy on large angular scales of increasing amplitude with energy.

arxiv-2503-19177.title: Life at the Boundary of Chemical Kinetics and Program Execution
arxiv-2503-19177.creator: Thomas Fischbacher
arxiv-2503-19177.description: Abstract Abstract This work introduces a generic quantitative framework for studying dynamical processes that involve interactions of polymer sequences. Possible applications range from quantitative studies of the reaction kinetics of polymerization processes to explorations of the behavior of chemical implementations of computational – including basic life-like – processes.

arxiv-2507-18787.title: Effects of matter with anisotropic pressure on the Fan-Wang regular black hole shadows
arxiv-2507-18787.creator: Yergali Kurmanov, Orlando Luongo, Daulet Berkimbayev, Kuantay Boshkayev, Talgar Konysbayev, Marco Muccino, Guldana Rabigulova
arxiv-2507-18787.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yergali Kurmanov, Orlando Luongo, Daulet Berkimbayev, Kuantay Boshkayev, Talgar Konysbayev, Marco Muccino, Guldana Rabigulova. We here investigate the consequences of an exotic fluid, exhibiting negative radial and tangential pressures, de facto violating the Zel’dovich limit, on a regular solution that easily generalizes the Schwarzschild black hole. More precisely, we focus on the regular Fan-Wang spacetime, computing how the black hole shadow images, surrounded by the quoted fluid, is modified through the presence of negative equations of state for the two pressure components.

arxiv-2601-11451.title: PRISM-CAFO: Prior-conditioned Remote-sensing Infrastructure Segmentation and Mapping for CAFOs
arxiv-2601-11451.creator: Oishee Bintey Hoque, Nibir Chandra Mandal, Kyle Luong, Amanda Wilson, Samarth Swarup, Madhav Marathe, Abhijin Adiga
arxiv-2601-11451.description: Abstract Large-scale livestock operations pose significant risks to human health and the environment, while also being vulnerable to threats such as infectious diseases and extreme weather events. As the number of such operations continues to grow, accurate and scalable mapping has become increasingly important.

arxiv-2602-20311.title: Evidence for Sympathetic Flaring in TESS Data
arxiv-2602-20311.creator: Veronica Pratt, Jason R. Reeves, David V. Martin, Andy B. Zhang, Andrew Korkus, S. Edelman
arxiv-2602-20311.description: Abstract Most flares on the Sun occur at random, but there is a small percentage of “sympathetic flaring” – the triggering of one flare by another. Previously there had been no widespread confirmation of sympathetic flares on other stars. In this work, we developed a new flare detection algorithm that is sensitive to closely-separated and overlapping stellar flares.

pmc-10506200.title: The role of health insurance literacy in the process and outcomes of choosing a health insurance policy in the Netherlands
pmc-10506200.creator: Laurens Holst, Adriana Elisabeth Maria Brabers, Jeannette Josepha Dingena Johanna Maria Rademakers, Judith Danielle de Jong
pmc-10506200.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In several countries, citizens are expected to be critical consumers when choosing a health insurance policy. However, there are indications that citizens do not always have the sufficient skills, so called health insurance literacy (HIL), to do this. We investigated whether the level of HIL among Dutch citizens is related to the way in which they experience the process of choosing a policy, and furthermore whether it is related to their health insurance choices.

pmc-10612011.title: Repeated Human Exposure to Semivolatile Organic Compounds by Inhalation: Novel Protocol for a Nonrandomized Study
pmc-10612011.creator: Elena Reale, Nancy B Hopf, Florian Breider, Dominique Grandjean, Catherine Pirard, Corinne Charlier, Holger M Koch, Aurélie Berthet, Guillaume Suarez, Myriam Borgatta
pmc-10612011.description: BackgroundSemivolatile organic compounds (SVOCs) comprise several different chemical families used mainly as additives in many everyday products. SVOCs can be released into the air as aerosols and deposit on particulate matter during use by dispersion, evaporation, or abrasion. Phthalates are SVOCs of growing concern due to their endocrine-disrupting effects.

pmc-11474207.title: Advancing acute MI care in densely populated low- and middle-income countries (LMICs): innovative stand-alone chest pain units for expedited triage and timely management
pmc-11474207.creator: Nadeem Qamar, Jawaid A. Sial, Tahir Sagir, Zair Hussain, Ali Zain Shah, Kamran Khan, Jehangir Ali Shah, Musa Karim, Shueeta Kumari, Sohail Khan, Sabha Bhatti, Abdul Hakeem
pmc-11474207.description: SummaryBackgroundThe incidence of myocardial infarction (MI) and its adverse effects on health and mortality remain high in densely populated low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). To address the issue of densely populated areas and timely access to primary PCI, chest pain units (CPUs) were deployed at strategic locations in Karachi, with a populace of over 23 million people.

pmc-11516815.creator: J Viñas Dozal, A M Autrán Gómez, M J Mondragon Delgado, C Palmeros Exome, J M Hurtado Capetillo, F Ruiz Garcia, R M Torres Hernandez, H Hernandez Ojeda, A A Ricardez Espinoza, J E Villegas-Dominguez
pmc-11516815.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionProstate Cancer (PCa) represents a health problem in the world and its management is heterogeneous in care, depending on the resources each country has, modifying its effectiveness in prevention, diagnosis, treatment and follow-up.MethodsThe UROLATAM program was implemented based on the Design Thinking quadruple helix innovation model, consisting of the immersion, design, idea and prototype phases, characterized by being multidisciplinary and comprehensive. Teachers and students from different careers at the Universidad Veracruzana participated.

pmc-11531131.title: Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver masquerading as a cystadenoma in a young adult: a case report
pmc-11531131.creator: Yanfang Huang, Xiao He, Linyu Shangguan, Yuli Zhou, Lexing Zhang, Yipai Wu
pmc-11531131.description: BackgroundUndifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver is an infrequent hepatic malignancy, primarily observed in the pediatric population. This neoplasm is exceedingly rare among adults. Despite its scarcity in adult cases, it remains imperative to accurately discern undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver utilizing diverse imaging modalities to prevent misdiagnosis with more prevalent benign and malignant hepatic masses.

pmc-11578345.title: Preserving the Immune‐Privileged Niche of the Nucleus Pulposus: Safeguarding Intervertebral Discs from Degeneration after Discectomy with Synthetic Mucin Hydrogel Injection (Adv. Sci. 43/2024)
pmc-11578345.creator: Huan Wang, Song Chen, Zhao Liu, Qingchen Meng, Rita Sobreiro‐Almeida, Ling Liu, Håvard Jostein Haugen, Jiaying Li, João F Mano, Youzhi Hong, Thomas Crouzier, Hongji Yan, Bin Li
pmc-11578345.description: Mucin Hydrogels The study by Song Chen, Hongji Yan, Bin Li, and co‐workers unequivocally establishes the multifaceted utility of mucin hydrogels (Muc‐gels), showcasing their efficacy as both a physical shielding barrier and an immune‐isolating barrier for nucleus pulposus. This novel dual‐functionality presents a promising avenue for mitigating the recurrence rate of discectomy and impeding the progression of intervertebral disc degeneration. More details can be found in article number 2404496.

pmc-11697541.title: Protocol for cellular RNA G-quadruplex profiling using G4RP.v2
pmc-11697541.creator: Jérémie Mitteaux, David Monchaud
pmc-11697541.description: SummaryThe isolation of G-quadruplexes (G4s) from human cells using specific molecular tools constitutes an invaluable step forward in uncovering the biology of these higher-order DNA and RNA structures. Here, we present an improved version of the G4-RNA precipitation (G4RP) protocol developed to identify RNA G4s from human cancer cells.

pmc-12683396.title: Redefining fatty liver as metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: Implications of nomenclature changes for patients with diabetes
pmc-12683396.creator: Tulio L Correa, Nikki Duong
pmc-12683396.description: The evolving nomenclature from non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) to metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) aims to better encompass the metabolic context of the disease. This change has significant implications for patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), given the frequent overlap between these conditions.

pmc-13251130.title: Biomimetic hybrid bioactive glasses gelatin composite rescues alveolar socket healing from diabetic impairment
pmc-13251130.creator: Eman M. Salem, Asmaa M. Abd El-Aziz, Wafaa Yahia Alghonemy, Rania A. Hanafy
pmc-13251130.description: BackgroundDiabetic individuals typically experience difficulties in healing their alveolar sockets due to impaired angiogenesis, persistent inflammation, and reduced osteoblastic activity. The development of biomimetic scaffolds that promote osteogenesis and restore the regenerative ability of diabetic bone remains a clinical necessity.

pmc-13380777.title: Sultams as Dual Inhibitors of Human Carbonic Anhydrase and Thioredoxin Reductase
pmc-13380777.creator: Aleksandrs Pustenko, Raitis Bobrovs, Venkatesan Saravanan, Kathir Avan, Simone Carradori, Antons Sizovs, Andrea Angeli, Claudiu T. Supuran, Raivis Žalubovskis
pmc-13380777.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cancer remains a leading cause of mortality, often complicated by drug resistance arising from single‐target therapies. Dual inhibitors that simultaneously target multiple cancer‐related defense mechanisms offer a promising strategy to overcome these limitations. Herein, we report the design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of a series of sultam‐based N‐acyl derivatives (8a–k and 9a–k) as potential dual inhibitors of thioredoxin reductase (TrxR1) and tumor‐associated carbonic anhydrases (CA IX and XII).
